people.name: Jabesh
people.line: Assassinated Zechariah; reigned as king of Israel for a month.

people.name: Shallum
people.line: King of Israel who conspired against Zechariah

translations.web: Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and struck him before the people, and killed him, and reigned in his place.
translations.bsb: Then Shallum son of Jabesh conspired against Zechariah, struck him down and killed him in front of the people, and reigned in his place.
translations.kjv: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
translations.asv: And Shallum the son of Jabesh conspired against him, and smote him before the people, and slew him, and reigned in his stead.
